scope: Static hand/forearm joint correction only; no full arm or movement
generator: built-in image_gen, cloud, two separate calls; service does not return price

prompts.hand: Use case: background-extraction. Create ONE isolated transparent PNG rig layer: the raised left HAND ONLY (viewer right) of the character in reference image 2. Image 1 is the original character and defines line weight, skin palette and illustration style. Image 2 is the accepted target pose: faithfully reproduce that specific narrow raised hand, its five fingers, thumb direction, proportions and slightly right-leaning orientation. Do not redesign or make a generic wide waving palm. No bracelets, no forearm, no character, no labels. Preserve the hand silhouette above the blue bracelet from image 2, then extend its wrist downward behind the removed bracelet by 16 source pixels in the same skin colour, as a flat overlap tab without a transverse border, oval cap or shading ring. Source-scale geometry on the original 1024x1536 canvas: visible hand about 90px wide by 122px tall; wrist width about 44px. Intended isolated native layer about 102x146px including transparent margin and overlap; if rendering larger, keep these exact proportions uniformly. The wrist should be broad enough to meet the reference forearm smoothly, not pinched into a small stalk. Simple restrained anime shading and thin warm brown outline. Real alpha transparency, clean antialiasing, no glow or background. Output a single hand layer.
prompts.forearm: Use case: stylized-concept. Output ONE isolated 2D anime FOREARM sprite on real transparent background, no other parts. Image 1 is the original character: match its thin warm brown line, pale peach skin and restrained flat shading. Image 2 is the accepted pose, raised left forearm on viewer right. Image 3 is the new isolated hand that will attach ABOVE this forearm; match its wrist colour, width and sloping side contours, but DO NOT draw the hand in this output. The forearm runs from a gently rounded wider ELBOW at bottom-left to a narrower WRIST at top-right, leaning 18 degrees right from vertical, like image 2. Source pixel geometry: centerline length 160px, elbow width 54px, wrist width 38px, very gentle natural taper; no hourglass waist, no bulging tube, no abrupt steps. Leave simple flat skin overlap at wrist and elbow. Do not draw transverse outlines, oval end faces, dark cuffs or shaded rings on the ends; these ends will overlap other sprites. Total content bounding box roughly 100px wide by 168px tall before transparent padding; render larger if needed with uniform proportions. No hand, fingers, bracelets, sleeve, upper arm, full character, background, text, diagrams, sheet or multiple parts. Single isolated forearm with thin clean outline along its long sides and minimal subtle shading matching the character.

hand.alpha_mask: A *= clamp((130-y)/8,0,1); RGB unchanged; bottom overlap only

forearm.rotation_method: ImageMagick transparent rotate, trim, 2 px border; unrotated PNG preserved

normalization.method: ImageMagick uniform resize; no anisotropic stretching

verification.scope: static wrist subassembly, not full arm or motion

limitations: Magnified wrist still has a small contour and colour transition; not accepted as seamless
